category_title: High-achieving dyslexic students using deep-level comprehension strategies
scenario_title: Homework and test preparation using textbook questions
minimal_context: The student is at home trying to answer textbook questions after reading a chapter to prepare for an upcoming test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read the chapter and answer the textbook questions to prepare for your test.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I finished reading, but when I try to answer the questions, I find I can't answer them. If I am interested in the material, then I will learn it at once, but if I am not interested in it, then it will take incredibly long to learn it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look back in the text to find the information you missed.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am looking back in the text, but it's not helping me understand. I want to do this together with someone who knows much about it. And who is prepared to work hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to write down the answers yourself first before we do anything else.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't just write them myself. I need you to sit reading in the book aloud to me. Then we talk about the topic afterwards, or you sit taking notes while I tell you about what I have learned.

task.content: Assessing own understanding of text content using questions and summaries contained in textbooks
task.learning_goal: Answering textbook questions after reading to monitor comprehension

context.materials: Textbooks, textbook questions, alternative information sources (Internet, newspapers, magazines)
context.social_setting: Collaborating with parents or a knowledgeable peer
context.time_context: Doing homework and preparing for tests

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: After reading, when they try to answer the questions and find they cannot answer them
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Looking back in the text, initiating collaboration with parents, asking to discuss the topic
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Motivated by a strong sense of agency and perceived self-efficacy to overcome the challenge
related_quotes: Together with someone who ...knows much about it. And who is prepared to work hard.

behavior_patterns.condition: When needing to process and remember text information for a test
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Actively initiates collaboration, asks partner to read aloud, or dictates notes for the partner to write down
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Interest in the material dictates the speed of learning
related_quotes: If I am interested in the material, then I will learn it at once, but if I am not interested in it, then it will take incredibly long to learn it.
